title: AliasMap
description: What agents call things vs what a system calls them. The team file (data/<id>/aliases.json) validates against this shape; team entries use "source": "team" and win over the ecosystem lexicon on the same alias.

alias.description: The name an agent is likely to write ('Card', 'spacing').

concept.description: The concept in plain words ('surface container', 'stack gap').

target.description: The name THIS system uses, when the team has mapped it. Absent in the ecosystem lexicon.

occurrences.description: How often models invented this exact name in the mined evidence (lexicon entries only).

source.description: 'lexicon': the ecosystem seed, mined and never hand-edited. 'team': this system's own alias file, wins on conflict. Optional in a team file: entries without it are treated as team entries when loaded.
